candidates.title: OD-MoE: On-Demand Expert Loading for Cacheless Edge-Distributed MoE Inference
candidates.reason: expert cacheを廃してmulti-layer activation predictorとdistributed edge nodesでjust-in-time expert loadingを行う。cacheless設計はexpert cache/offload系の重要な比較点。

candidates.title: SP-MoE: Speculative Decoding and Prefetching for Accelerating MoE-based Model Inference
candidates.reason: speculative decodingをexpert prefetch signalとして使い、SD時のGPU memory・PCIe contentionを扱うMoE offload system。

candidates.title: DuoServe-MoE: Dual-Phase Expert Prefetch and Cache Scheduling for Efficient MoE LLM Inference
candidates.reason: prefillとdecodeでexpert activation特性が異なる点を利用し、phase別のprefetch/cache schedulingを設計する。

candidates.title: PreScope: Unleashing the Power of Prefetching for Resource-Constrained MoE Inference
candidates.reason: layer-aware predictor、cross-layer prefetch scheduling、asynchronous I/Oを統合しPCIe bottleneckを狙うMoE inference system。

candidates.title: MoE-SpAc: Efficient MoE Inference Based on Speculative Activation Utility in Heterogeneous Edge Scenarios
candidates.reason: speculative decodingをexpert demand lookaheadとして使い、heterogeneous workload balancingとprefetch/evictionを統合する。

discovery_stats.query_summary: 2025-2026のMoE offload/prefetch系を系譜探索し、cacheless loading、SD-aware prefetch、phase-aware scheduling、cross-layer scheduling、speculative utilityの5つの異なる設計をmain canonical ID検索で未収録確認した。
